user.title: Gree Offline server
user.description: Runs the local discovery server. Pick the Gree region your units belong to. Leave the advertised IP blank to auto-detect. With a router DNS redirect of REGION.dis.gree.com and mqtt-REGION.gree.com to this host, units reach Gree only while being onboarded here, and even then never receive cloud commands. Without the redirect they use Gree's cloud directly.

data.resolver: External DNS used to reach Gree when your DNS redirects its names (comma-separated)
data.sink_delay: Seconds before closing a unit's MQTT retry (longer = fewer retries, slower local replies)
